subject: Exec approval request: Sable Health VPC constraints + commercial concession
messages:
From: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@sablehealth.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@sablehealth.com, Emma White <emma.white@procurelaw.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Request: VPC hosting + residency requirements (Sable Health)

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the demo last week — the product looks promising for our clinical NLP workloads. We have two non-negotiable requirements from procurement & legal before moving to commercial terms:

- VPC-only deployment (no shared multitenant host) with private networking to our AWS account.
- US-only data residency and a contractual audit clause limited to quarterly read-only reviews with 30 days notice.

We also need visibility into key logs and the ability to perform a red-team-style control review (non-invasive) once per year. Our budget for year one is constrained; to get to an internal ok we need a price concession in the first 12 months (looking for ~25% off list).

I attached the RFP and procurement checklist. Can Redwood support these constraints and a short pilot (3 months) with those terms?

Regards,
Rajiv
Head of Procurement
Sable Health

Attachments: Sable_RFP.pdf
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@sablehealth.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: VPC hosting + residency requirements (Sable Health)

Hi Rajiv —

Appreciate the clarity and the RFP. Short answer: yes, we can do a private VPC deployment and US-only residency. A few clarifying items so we can scope the legal language and the commercial concession:

1) Audit cadence: you requested quarterly read-only reviews + a red-team once/year. We typically allow 1 full audit per 12 months for on-prem/VPC customers, plus automated read-only log access that we can provide on-demand with 30 days notice. Can you confirm which of the quarterly reviews are programmatic (log review) vs. in-person/forensic?

2) Pilot length & discount: pilot 3 months sounds fine. To make it work commercially we need to confirm expected token/throughput profile for sizing. Our initial proposal would be a one-time onboarding fee + a 22% discount for year 1 (subject to exec approval).

3) Security artifacts: we can share SOC2 snapshot and a runbook for network setup; I'll attach SOC2.

I'll loop in Rishi (legal) to draft a redline against your master terms. Laura, can you confirm deal economics (ARR estimate) and whether 22% is sufficient to close?

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0172

Attachments: SOC2-snapshot-2026.pdf
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@sablehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 08:42:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Request: VPC hosting + residency requirements (Sable Health)

Kimberly / Rajiv —

Thanks for laying out the asks. From a legal/compliance perspective we can accommodate a VPC-only deployment and US-only residency but we need to tighten the audit language:

- Our standard for Private/VPC customers is one physical/forensic audit per 12 months. We can offer programmatic, read-only log access quarterly given reasonable notice (30 days).
- Any onsite or intrusive testing (red-team, vulnerability verification) must be scoped, agreed in writing, and restricted to a single coordinated event per 12 months.
- We require a narrow discovery scope and non-disclosure for any findings; we will not permit unbounded data access.

Commercial concessions: the master terms redline is attached. Legal will not accept an uncapped 25% discount without an ARR/commitment threshold. If the customer commits to an annualized spend >= $350k we can support up to 22% year-one discount; anything beyond that requires VP signoff.

Kimberly — can you provide the ARR projection and expected pilot consumption so I can finalize the redline?

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@sablehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 10:11:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Request: VPC hosting + residency requirements (Sable Health)

Team —

Quick commercial context: Sable has indicated an ARR target in-year of $375,000 if pilot converts. They are sensitive to upfront spend and procurement wants the first 12 months to be discounted. Given that ARR, I can support the 22% concession Rishi proposed.

Operational asks we should confirm before final:
- Onboarding fee: waive if they commit to the annual plan post-pilot.
- Pilot scope: 3 months, capped token usage (we need their expected qps / peak seq length).

If we're aligned on 22% + audit constraints limited to read-only quarterly + one scoped red-team/year, I'll put this forward to Jonas for approval of the commercial exception.

Laura Bennett
Director, Sales | Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 13:27:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Exec approval request: Sable Health VPC constraints + commercial concession

Jonas —

Forwarding for exec signoff. Summary and ask below:

- Account: Sable Health (Healthcare, US)
- Deal id: S-2026-047
- Expected ARR if pilot converts: ~$375k
- Asks from customer: private VPC deployment, US-only data residency, quarterly read-only log reviews (30 days notice), one scoped red-team/year. Procurement requested ~25% discount year-one.

Internal recommendation (Legal + Sales):
- Approve a capped commercial exception: 22% discount year-one contingent on signed commitment >= $350k ARR, waive onboarding fee if they commit to annual plan post-pilot, SOC2 snapshot and KMS-managed keys.
- Audit terms: programmatic read-only access quarterly (30d notice) + one scoped red-team/on-site per 12 months with narrow discovery and NDA; no unfettered data access.

Attachments: Sable_Master_Terms_v2_redlines.pdf (legal redline), SOC2-snapshot-2026.pdf

Can you confirm approval (or state changes) so we can return to procurement/legal and proceed to signatures?

Thanks,
Kimberly
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 15:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Exec approval request: Sable Health VPC constraints + commercial concession

Kimberly —

Thanks for the clear summary. I approve the exception on the following conditions:

1) 22% year-one discount only if Sable commits to >= $350k ARR via DocuSign within 30 days of pilot completion.
2) Onboarding fee waived conditional on executed annual commitment.
3) Audit terms as proposed by Legal: quarterly programmatic read-only log access (30 days notice) and one scoped red-team/forensic event per 12 months; all tests require an agreed statement of work and limited discovery scope.
4) All traffic and data must remain in US regions; customer to provide AWS account for VPC peering and KMS key access control.

If those conditions are acceptable to Sable, Kimberly, please coordinate signatures and update the HubSpot deal with the approved concession and the DocuSign envelope id.

Jonas Weber
VP, Revenue | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
